title: [Effects and mechanisms of Supplemented Shenqi Dihuang Decoction Formula in improving podocyte pyroptosis in diabetic kidney disease by regulating dyslipidemia-mediated lipid droplet accumulation and TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway].
authors: Shen, Hao-Wen; Xu, Xin-Mei; Wan, Yi-Gang; Chen, Ping; Li, Ya-Jing; Liu, Ying-Lu; Wu, Wei; Fang, Qi-Jun; He, Qi-Han; Sang, Tian-Qing; Chong, Fee-Lan
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药复方通过调节脂质代谢和TLR4/NF-κB通路改善糖尿病肾病足细胞焦亡，属于纯湿实验和网络药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects and mechanisms of the Supplemented Shenqi Dihuang Decoction Formula(SSDDF) in improving podocyte pyroptosis in diabetic kidney disease(DKD) by regulating dyslipidemia-mediated lipid droplet accumulation and the Toll-like receptor 4(TLR4)/myeloid differentiation primary response gene 88(MyD88)/nuclear factor-kappaB(NF-kappaB) signaling pathway. First, a modified DKD rat model was established. After successful modeling, the DKD rats were administered low-dose SSDDF(SSDDF-L), high-dose SSDDF(SSDDF-H), dapagliflozin(DAPA), or saline(vehicle) by gavage for six consecutive weeks. In the in vivo study, the general condition of the rats, blood glucose(BG), urinary albumin(UAlb), liver and renal function indexes, blood lipid profiles, and serum short-chain fatty acid(SCFA) levels were examined. Glomerular histopathological features, podocyte foot process morphology, and glomerular basement membrane(GBM) ultrastructure were compared. The protein expression levels of podocyte slit diaphragm structural molecules(nephrin and podocin) in renal tissue, key signaling molecules of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway [TLR4, MyD88, phosphorylated inhibitor of NF-kappaBalpha(p-IkappaBalpha), and phosphorylated NF-kappaB p65(p-p65)],key molecules of the classical pyroptosis pathway [NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain-associated protein 3(NLRP3), apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD(ASC), cleaved-caspase-1, and gasdermin D-N(GSDMD-N)], and effector inflammatory factors [interleukin-1beta(IL-1beta) and interleukin-18(IL-18)] were analyzed. Second, in the in vitro study, a lipotoxic podocyte injury model was constructed by treating MPC-5 cells with high glucose(HG) and palmitic acid(PA). The injured cells were then treated with either SSDDF-H-containing serum or the TLR4 inhibitor TAK-242. The lipid droplet characteristics and the expression levels of proteins associated with the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway and pyroptosis in podocytes were observed and analyzed. Additionally, in the network pharmacology study, potential targets of SSDDF and DKD were predicted and screened using the HERB and SwissTargetPrediction databases, and a "drug-component-target network" of SSDDF was constructed. DKD-related targets were integrated from the OMIM, GeneCards, and TTD databases. Gene Ontology(GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes(KEGG) pathway enrichment analyses for the intersecting targets were performed using the DAVID database. Molecular docking was performed between the core components of SSDDF and key targets. The network pharmacology results suggested that the therapeutic effects of SSDDF on DKD were likely related to the regulation of lipid metabolism and inflammation-related signaling pathways. The in vivo results showed that SSDDF-L and SSDDF-H improved, to varying degrees, the general condition and the levels of BG, UAlb, serum creatinine(Scr), blood urea nitrogen(BUN), total cholesterol(TC), triglyceride(TG), the ratio of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol(LDL-C) to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol(HDL-C), and SCFA in DKD rats, ameliorated glomerular histopathological changes and podocyte ultrastructure, and improved renal protein expression levels of nephrin, podocin, TLR4, MyD88, p-IkappaBalpha, p-p65, NLRP3, ASC, cleaved caspase-1, GSDMD-N, IL-1beta, and IL-18. Notably, regarding the improvement of proteinuria in the modified DKD rats, SSDDF was less effective than DAPA. However, for renal function and SCFA levels, SSDDF-H was superior to DAPA, and for blood lipid regulation, glomerulosclerosis, and podocyte injury, SSDDF showed similar efficacy to DAPA. The in vitro results showed that both SSDDF-H-containing serum and the TLR4 inhibitor reduced lipid droplet accumulation, inhibited TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway activation, and alleviated podocyte pyroptosis, with comparable effects. In conclusion, SSDDF ameliorates podocyte pyroptosis in DKD by regulating dyslipidemia-mediated lipid droplet accumulation and the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. These findings provide pharmacological evidence for precisely elucidating the scientific connotation of the Jinling school's therapeutic approach to "Shenxiao disease".
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨加味参芪地黄汤（SSDDF）通过调节血脂异常介导的脂滴积聚及Toll样受体4（TLR4）/髓样分化初级反应基因88（MyD88）/核因子-κB（NF-κB）信号通路，改善糖尿病肾病（DKD）足细胞焦亡的作用及机制。首先，建立改良DKD大鼠模型。建模成功后，DKD大鼠分别灌胃给予低剂量SSDDF（SSDDF-L）、高剂量SSDDF（SSDDF-H）、达格列净（DAPA）或生理盐水（vehicle），连续六周。在体内研究中，检测大鼠一般状况、血糖（BG）、尿白蛋白（UAlb）、肝肾功能指标、血脂谱及血清短链脂肪酸（SCFA）水平。比较肾小球组织病理学特征、足细胞足突形态及肾小球基底膜（GBM）超微结构。分析肾组织中足细胞裂孔隔膜结构分子（nephrin和podocin）、TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路关键信号分子[TLR4、MyD88、磷酸化NF-κB抑制剂α（p-IκBα）和磷酸化NF-κB p65（p-p65）]、经典焦亡通路关键分子[NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NLRP3）、凋亡相关斑点样蛋白含CARD（ASC）、cleaved-caspase-1和gasdermin D-N（GSDMD-N）]及效应炎症因子[白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和白细胞介素-18（IL-18）]的蛋白表达水平。其次，在体外研究中，通过高糖（HG）和棕榈酸（PA）处理MPC-5细胞构建脂毒性足细胞损伤模型。随后，损伤细胞分别用含SSDDF-H血清或TLR4抑制剂TAK-242处理。观察并分析足细胞中脂滴特征及TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路和焦亡相关蛋白的表达水平。此外，在网络药理学研究中，利用HERB和SwissTargetPrediction数据库预测并筛选SSDDF和DKD的潜在靶点，构建SSDDF的“药物-成分-靶点网络”。从OMIM、GeneCards和TTD数据库整合DKD相关靶点。使用DAVID数据库对交集靶点进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。对SSDDF核心成分与关键靶点进行分子对接。网络药理学结果表明，SSDDF对DKD的治疗作用可能与调节脂质代谢和炎症相关信号通路有关。体内结果显示，SSDDF-L和SSDDF-H在不同程度上改善了DKD大鼠的一般状况及BG、UAlb、血清肌酐（Scr）、血尿素氮（BUN）、总胆固醇（TC）、甘油三酯（TG）、低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（HDL-C）比值及SCFA水平，减轻了肾小球组织病理学改变和足细胞超微结构损伤，并改善了肾组织中nephrin、podocin、TLR4、MyD88、p-IκBα、p-p65、NLRP3、ASC、cleaved-caspase-1、GSDMD-N、IL-1β和IL-18的蛋白表达水平。值得注意的是，在改善改良DKD大鼠蛋白尿方面，SSDDF的效果不如DAPA。然而，在肾功能和SCFA水平方面，SSDDF-H优于DAPA；在血脂调节、肾小球硬化和足细胞损伤方面，SSDDF显示出与DAPA相似的疗效。体外结果显示，含SSDDF-H血清和TLR4抑制剂均减少了脂滴积聚，抑制了TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB通路激活，并减轻了足细胞焦亡，且效果相当。总之，SSDDF通过调节血脂异常介导的脂滴积聚及TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB信号通路，改善DKD中的足细胞焦亡。这些发现为精确阐明金陵学派“肾消病”治疗思路的科学内涵提供了药理学证据。
